cohort: 16 inspected Izu vascular-plant taxa; development only

taxon_influence.interpretation: The development lift is not driven by one or two taxa, but it is not uniform: three strongest-benefit taxa are sufficient to move the residual mean below the +0.015 practical threshold.

budget_dependence.K5: q=0.10 selected in every cross-taxon jackknife fit and the all-taxa fit
budget_dependence.K10_K20_K40: q=1.0 selected; ecological restriction did not survive
budget_dependence.interpretation: The supported development object is a low-budget policy, not a universal fixed environmental mask.

robustness_conclusion: Development evidence is robust to single-taxon removal and most moderate taxon subsets, but benefits are concentrated rather than universal. This supports freezing the low-budget K5 policy for a genuinely new cross-island, cross-taxon confirmation; it does not justify skipping external confirmation.
